title: Gobbler evidence vocabulary and bounded integration register
scope: Public project terms, baseline field semantics, and proposed acceptance work. Not an OWL ontology, executable reasoner, complete event JSON Schema, or evidence certification.

sources.use: Potential future graph-constraint language; not executed by this vocabulary.
Documented scene/browser operations; acceptance remains pinned-runtime-specific.
Checkpoint and store scope; application side effects require their own recovery.

classes.definition: A named immutable view of source material, with exact bytes and repository pins.
A claim that a source passage contains a stated item; distinct from proving the item's empirical truth.
A proposed X3D fragment, model, or other artifact before the relevant acceptance activity.
A normalized representation generated from a raw input by a named normalization activity.
A bounded reported failure with affected subject and source references.
Versioned executable or declarative conditions for a named failure class.
An immutable recorded result, instrument identity, inputs, conditions, outputs, and scope.
A positive and negative fixture pair bound to the same acceptance question.
A separately identified artifact that consumes a result or guard.
An explicit claim of consumer uptake supported by a separate acceptance record.
A question, permitted intervention, expected invariant, and observation scope.
A real execution with identified input entities and instrument; simulation is an explicit mode.
A raw-to-canonical conversion whose preserved properties and losses are declared.
A human or automated judgment with judge type and task; never interchangeable implicitly.
A person, software instrument, or organization associated with an activity.
An integration category such as maths, STEM or music; membership does not establish activity.

properties.definition: Input consumed by the named activity.
Receipt generated by an activity; orientation follows wasGeneratedBy.
Representation derivation, without an equivalence claim.
Scoped support for exactly the stated assertion.
Positive and negative inputs plus expectations.
Evidence of actual consumer acceptance, not just a draft.
Question and counterfactual derived from an incident.
Categorization, not evidence of distinct organizational adoption.
A later scoped record revises the current result without deleting historical evidence.
Explicit tension between results requiring input/instrument comparison.

facets.note: Facets are independent. No total ordering, confidence scalar, probability calibration or automatic grade promotion is defined.

identity_rules.rule: Identify exact byte entities by cryptographic digest and encoding; retain raw and canonical identities separately.
A run has its own operation/run ID, input entities, exact instrument and conditions. Two repeated runs can use the same input.
The existing synthetic protocol deduplicates guard/target/input-hash tuples. External adoption additionally needs consumer identity and an acceptance activity.
A later run can supersede a result for current use without rewriting the earlier historical record.
Every grade must name the assertion and evidence facet it summarizes. Presence is not behavior or adoption.
Hash agreement establishes identity/consistency under the declared digest operation, not authorship, valid inference or empirical truth.

proposed_receipt_minimum.claim: Precisely worded assertion and acceptance question.
proposed_receipt_minimum.input_artifacts: Raw/canonical identity, digest algorithm, encoding and optional repository commit.
proposed_receipt_minimum.instrument: Version/full revision, imported source identity, configuration and environment.
proposed_receipt_minimum.mode: Real execution, simulation, authored fixture or historical import explicitly identified.
proposed_receipt_minimum.status: Execution status separate from freshness and evidence facet.
proposed_receipt_minimum.outputs: Result artifacts with hashes and declared conversion losses.
proposed_receipt_minimum.conditions: Units, coordinate frame, numerical tolerance, task/split/device settings as applicable.
proposed_receipt_minimum.controls: Nearby valid/defective twins with expected and observed outcomes.
proposed_receipt_minimum.consumer: Present only where a separate consumer uptake claim is being made.
proposed_receipt_minimum.note: Proposed common interface; not all current records implement every field.
